content: Anvi Desai inquired about details of the comprehensive insurance plan with agent Anita Sharma. Anita clarified specialist-visit coverage (80% up to $5,000), pre-authorization rules for consults over $200, and the October 30 renewal deadline (with a current premium lock if confirmed by October 20), sharing the plan brochure. Anvi expressed satisfaction and requested the renewal form, which Anita agreed to email.
